missing_policy: Required-by-phase matrix, not all-fixed-missing equals failure. Read-only incompleteness never stops healthy native work; it withholds eligibility.
nested_owned_evidence: Keep complete command receipt JSON unchanged, including keeper_control and all inventory_receipts bytepacks inline. Decode/rehash independently; do not replace originals by summaries.
owner_start_consumer: Pure LOCAL/OFFLINE validation of exported original bytes and hash links; no private-helper execution or remote source evaluator replay.

required_by_phase.before_native: copy/qualification/ARM controls only; warm/commit files normally absent
required_by_phase.candidate_start: complete selected end/start chains, first/full proof, prestart admission, owner-start and commit; missing/partial/mismatched field means not eligible
required_by_phase.formal_entry: candidate_start plus actual postcommit owned-native CAPTURE entry or stronger consistent formal evidence; commit alone is insufficient
required_by_phase.target_final: all current duration/monitor/target/audit/restored controls plus mandatory verified start bundle; no new earlier duration credit
required_by_phase.warm_failed: every existing budget/binding/first/full/attempt/witness control plus actual failure/restoration; no owner-start required for owned journal provenance
required_by_phase.warm_started: budget, enable-request and start-binding after their original creation; missing later controls pending
